set -e
TESTDIR=/tmp/legacy-web-check
rm -rf "$TESTDIR"; mkdir "$TESTDIR"
BASE="http://$NODE_IP:8080"
fetch() { name="$1"; shift; code=$(env -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY /usr/bin/curl -sS -o "$TESTDIR/$name.body" -D "$TESTDIR/$name.headers" -w '%{http_code}' "$@" 2>"$TESTDIR/$name.err"); printf '%-26s HTTP %s bytes=%s\n' "$name" "$code" "$(wc -c < "$TESTDIR/$name.body")"; }
fetch public "$BASE/public/"
cmp "$TESTDIR/public.body" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/index.html && echo 'public body matches staged index: yes'
fetch staff_no_auth "$BASE/staff/"
fetch staff_file_no_auth "$BASE/staff/roster.csv"
fetch staff_wrong -u 'reader:definitely-wrong' "$BASE/staff/"
USER_NAME=$(sudo -n awk -F': *' 'tolower($1) ~ /username/ {sub(/\r$/, "", $2); print $2}' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt)
USER_PASS=$(sudo -n awk -F': *' 'tolower($1) ~ /password/ {sub(/\r$/, "", $2); print $2}' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt)
[ "$USER_NAME" = reader ]
fetch staff_valid -u "$USER_NAME:$USER_PASS" "$BASE/staff/"
fetch staff_file_valid -u "$USER_NAME:$USER_PASS" "$BASE/staff/roster.csv"
unset USER_PASS
cmp "$TESTDIR/staff_valid.body" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html && echo 'authenticated staff index matches staged file: yes'
cmp "$TESTDIR/staff_file_valid.body" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/roster.csv && echo 'authenticated staff file matches staged file: yes'
for name in staff_no_auth staff_file_no_auth staff_wrong; do grep -qi '^WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="Staff"' "$TESTDIR/$name.headers" && echo "$name challenge header: yes"; done

fetch access_encoded "$BASE/%2e%2e/access.txt"
